requests.name: m_carseat_shell_spreads_force
requests.why: 육아_27 4칸(29.53~36.86초 '미국 도로교통안전국은 차가 부딪힐 때 뒤보기 카시트가 아기를 등받이째 감싸 받쳐서, 목에 가는 충격을 줄여 준다고 해요', 7.3초) 단독. 갑자기 멈추는 차 안에서 빈 뒤보기 카시트의 넓은 등받이 껍데기가 앞에서 오는 힘을 받아 뒤로 살짝 기대며, 호박색 힘이 한 점이 아니라 등받이·머리 날개 전체로 고르게 퍼졌다가 옅어진다. ⚠️ 근거(NHTSA 'cradles and moves with your child to reduce the stress')만큼만 — 수치·'다치지 않는다'는 그리지 않는다. 충돌·파편·찌그러짐 없이 도식으로. 색인 전수 확인(충격·충격 흡수·분산·받쳐 줌·impact force·whiplash·car seat) — m_bone_stress(뼈 실금)·m_haircell_damage(귀 충격파)뿐, 카시트 장면 0건. 아기 단어·몸 없이 사물만. 범용 — 카시트 방향·뒤보기 원리·카시트 고르기 편에 쓴다. | 10-12 1판 반려(_v1): 1초 뒤 일반 자동차 시트로 바뀜 → Object lock 문장 추가.

requests.flow: One continuous shot in a single unbroken scene with no scene cuts. 0-2s: from the very first frame the whole translucent car cabin lurches to a sudden stop, and soft translucent ripple lines sweep from the front of the cabin toward the empty rear-facing seat, the camera swinging fast around to the side of the seat. 2-4s: the ripples meet the broad backrest of the seat shell, the shell rocks gently back into the bench and its headrest wings flex a little, and a soft warm amber wash spreads evenly across the whole inner surface of the backrest and the headrest wings at once, from the head end down to the bottom, never collecting in one point. 4-6s: the seat settles still, the amber wash fades evenly back to pale cyan across the whole shell, the camera pulling back to show the calm cabin until the very last frame. Nothing breaks, cracks, flies loose or dents at any moment. Style lock: every structure stays rendered as the same translucent pale cyan glass with softly glowing edges in the dark slate blue-grey void from the first frame to the very last; the scene never turns opaque, matte, mint green, beige, illustrated or photorealistic. No human figure, no person, no hand, no face and nothing sitting in the seat anywhere in the frame. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows anywhere in the frame. Low ambient synth hum with one soft dull thump and a faint creak of the seat shell, no music, no dialogue. Object lock: it is the same translucent child car safety seat from the start frame for the entire clip — the deep bucket-shaped shell with tall side headrest wings and the five-point harness straps stay visible the whole time; it never changes into an ordinary adult car seat, never morphs, and no new seat appears.
